draft.subject: enquiries after hours
draft.body:
Hi Elena,

Your website only offers a contact form, with no chat, online booking or after-hours line.

We built an AI legal assistant platform for research and document help for a legal-tech venture.

Is this on your radar?

claims.text: Your website only offers a contact form, with no chat, online booking or after-hours line
We built an AI legal assistant platform for research and document help for a legal-tech venture

evidence.text: Intake Paralegal. Answer new client enquiries, run conflict checks and schedule consultations.
No live chat, online booking or after-hours phone line was found on the website; the Contact page offers a form only.

facts.wording: Built an AI legal assistant platform for research and document help for a legal-tech venture (Legal AI).
ABA Formal Opinion 512 says a lawyer needs the client's informed consent before putting client information into a self-learning generative AI tool.
A 17+ person team of engineers, AI specialists and analysts, based in San Jose.
